title: The False Criterion
subtitle: A criterion nothing declares
description: The condition below asks for an advancement the player has, but names a criterion
the advancement does not declare. A criterion name is not validated -- the game's
own advancement files decide what exists, and a quest file cannot be checked against
them -- so this reads as *not done* and the gate stays shut.
That is the honest behaviour, and it used to be a crash: the criterion's progress is
null for a name nothing declares, and dereferencing it took down whatever asked -- the
tick, every second, and the lock refresh with it. A typo should lock a gate, not end
